# Module `ldp.session`

> Session lifecycle and privileged configuration: lock/unlock, idle stages, suspend/resume, shutdown notice, inhibitors, and display configuration (layout, modes, scale, transform, VRR policy, HDR, backlight).

## Interfaces

### `ldp.session.session`

The session lifecycle interface. Events mirror logind transitions; inhibitors are cookies that delay power management until released (via connection.destroy of the returned object) or the client disconnects.

*global (registry-advertised)*

### `ldp.session.display_config`

Privileged output reconfiguration. Collect changes with `configure`, then apply them atomically at a vblank with `apply`. Every applied change is reflected back as output events on the affected ldp.core.output objects.

#### Requests

| Opcode | Name | Since | Reply | Arguments |
|---:|---|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `get_outputs` | 1 | `applied` | — |
| 2 | `configure` | 1 | — | `output: object<ldp.core.output>`, `position_x: int32`, `position_y: int32`, `scale_q8: uint32`, `transform: enum<ldp.core.transform>`, `mode_id: uint32`, `vrr: enum<vrr_policy>`, `hdr_enabled: bool` |
| 3 | `apply` | 1 | `applied` | — |
| 4 | `get_brightness` | 1 | `brightness` | `output: object<ldp.core.output>` |
| 5 | `set_brightness` | 1 | — | `output: object<ldp.core.output>`, `level: uint32` |

* `configure.position_x` — Position in the global logical layout.
* `configure.scale_q8` — Scale in 1/256 units.
* `configure.mode_id` — Mode ID from output.mode events.
